description: Check a document for hidden text before your agent reads it. PDF, Office, RTF, HTML.
name: ai.hiddencontent/mcp

environmentVariables.description: API token for the HiddenContent service. Get one at https://hiddencontent.ai — the server refuses to start without it and says so.
environmentVariables.name: HCS_API_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the service. Defaults to the hosted API; set it only when pointing at a self-hosted instance.
environmentVariables.name: HCS_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of actions this agent can actually take (for example: send_email,make_payment). Techniques like unauthorized-action and exfiltration only evaluate against what you declare, so declaring more can raise severity and declaring nothing leaves those checks inert.
environmentVariables.name: HCS_CAPABILITIES

title: HiddenContent
